name: license-sentinel
description: Audit Python and npm dependency licenses for compliance before you ship. Flags GPL/AGPL/SSPL, source-available (BUSL/Elastic) and non-commercial licenses against how you distribute your product.

tools.name: audit_project
tools.description: Scan a project's dependencies and report licensing risk against your distribution context.

tools.name: check_package
tools.description: Check a license string (or several joined by AND/OR) against your distribution context.

tools.name: generate_notices
tools.description: Write a THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md attribution document for the project's dependencies.
